The '''''Vigilance''''' was a [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] that served with the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Suubrin]] and in circa [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] was sent on a [[Destruction|mission]] to investigate an [[abandoned Separatist base]]. It arrived in the system where the base was and attacked some [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and some [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] that were there. Troops were landed from it to the base, and Suubrin then flew it to investigate a mystery [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that had just arrived. This turned out to be flown by the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], and he landed on the ''Vigilance''.
